lede: The most consequential thing on the calendar this week is the Gondola Leadership Committee meeting on July 28, where the agenda flags an action item on background and history alongside a walkthrough of the Capital Investment Grant program and funding commitments — language that suggests real decisions, not just updates, are on the table. Town Council also convenes Monday as the Liquor Licensing Authority to hold a public hearing on KOTO's Live at the Drive permit for July 30. Sprinkled through the week: Shakespeare in the Park, Box Canyon Races, and The Music Man wrapping its run at the Sheridan.

notable.stake: Public hearing on KOTO's outdoor Live at the Drive liquor permit.
Action items on gondola funding commitments and Capital Investment Grant program.
